tools.name: roast_post
tools.description: Evaluate a draft social post against the live music industry news cycle. Returns critical editorial feedback, quality score (0-100), timeliness verdict, and an improved rewrite. Does NOT publish or modify content.

tools.name: get_voice_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the authenticated user brand voice profile including tone guidelines, sample posts, forbidden words, and style formatting toggles. Returns null if default house voice is active.

tools.name: set_voice_profile
tools.description: Save custom brand voice settings (tone, sample posts, avoid words, emoji/hashtag rules) for the authenticated user. Applied to future Jacks.

tools.name: get_generation_config
tools.description: Retrieve the sampling, length, and additional writing rules applied when NewsJack creates a Jack.

tools.name: set_generation_config
tools.description: Update the sampling, length, and additional writing rules used for future Jacks.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List all news sources monitored for your account, including custom RSS feeds and disabled global source overrides.

tools.name: add_source
tools.description: Add a new RSS or Atom feed URL to automated news monitoring. Feeds are polled every 5 minutes.

tools.name: remove_source
tools.description: Delete a custom news feed by its ID. Use list_sources to find source IDs.

tools.name: toggle_source
tools.description: Pause or resume one of the account’s own custom RSS sources, identified by source_id from list_sources. It only works on feeds added with add_source. To mute or unmute one of NewsJack’s built-in publications, use disable_global_source and enable_global_source, which take the publication name instead

tools.name: disable_global_source
tools.description: Mute one of NewsJack’s built-in publications so its Stories stop appearing in this account’s feed. Identify it by its exact publication name. For a custom RSS feed the account added itself, use toggle_source with its source_id instead. Reversible with enable_global_source and idempotent.

tools.name: enable_global_source
tools.description: Unmute a built-in publication previously muted with disable_global_source, so its Stories return to this account’s feed. Pass the same exact name; list_sources shows the muted ones. Custom RSS feeds are resumed with toggle_source instead. Idempotent: unmuting a publication that is not muted changes

tools.description: List the signed-in account’s Posts from the library, filtered by lifecycle status and ordered by scheduled_for (soonest first, unscheduled last). By default it returns the scheduled queue. Pass status "all" to list every Post (drafts, waiting, posted and failed), which makes it the general Post list

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule a draft post for publishing at a designated future time. Supply content directly or reference existing content_id.

tools.name: cancel_scheduled
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled Post: move it from scheduled or ready back to draft and clear its scheduled time, so it leaves the publishing queue. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_stories, get_story, get_voice_profile, list_sources, list_scheduled · Private data: list_stories, export_to_tap · Public sink: generate_post, generate_post_dry_run, roast_post, list_scheduled, schedule_post, cancel_scheduled, export_to_tap · Destructive: list_stories, generate_post_dry_run, roast_post, remove_source.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_stories, get_story, get_voice_profile, list_sources, list_scheduled · Private data: list_stories, export_to_tap · Public sink: generate_post, generate_post_dry_run, roast_post, list_scheduled, schedule_post, cancel_scheduled, export_to_tap · Destructive: list_stories, generate_post_dry_run, roast_post, remove_source

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
